explanations.general: Correct answer: pronounces r after vowels (car, work)

questions.questionText: UK linking r: “far away” sounds like “fa-______”. (complete)
Both rhotic and non-rhotic accents pronounce r before a vowel, as in “very”.

questions.questionText: Mixing rhotic and non-rhotic in the same speech is the clearest option.
